scope: Studio capture of all twelve current imported character rigs using production pose adapters. Pose review only; gameplay damage and collision are verified by the separate runtime suites.

pose_sources.goemon: HeroModel with pipe_combo_active, rogue_pipe_combo_active and equipped enabled; goemon_rogue_combo timing and production HeroLocomotion. First contact is 0.15 / 0.48 progress.
pose_sources.edo: MusashiModel and real MusashiCombat FIREBALL / MOVING states, sampled through goemon_cosplay_motion.
pose_sources.native_classes: Actual imported Actor models; class_actions PRIMARY / SAMURAI_CUTS and rogue_roster_combat COMBO data; primary flag enables articulated costume posing. Mage uses its release shot state, Ranger uses its bow attack state.

visual_review.observations: All twelve labels and full bodies are visible. Inspected poses show turning torsos, bent elbows, raised rear heels and bent knees. Weapons remain attached in the inspected frames; long weapons stay within their panels. Initial Goemon contact preview used the older profile and was replaced before final encoding with the active Rogue pipe profile.
visual_review.limits: This studio intentionally shows pose and equipment, without live projectile effects or damage targets. Native figures run in place; original Goemon uses its terrain foot IK with actual model translation.
